protocol.scope: retrospective fixed sites; original masks reused; no new geographic search or cross-site candidates/corrections
protocol.prior_fit: historical training satellite groups only; frozen before validation and DS5
protocol.candidate_selection: all tracks, all catalogue: training-only OLS coarse -60..60 step15 top3/site/track plus previous training-zero winner; no test access
protocol.joint_selection: multi-start coordinate ascent of training integrated shared-timing evidence; approximate, not identity marginalization
protocol.support: continuous priors conditioned on numerical support; omitted prior mass explicitly reported
protocol.clock: sigma1s truncated +/-3s; sensitivity with identities frozen from no-clock joint selection
protocol.observation_independence: approximation; no new heldout radio validation
